_readme: The examples row on the dashboard. Every card here is somebody else's live site: this file holds a title, a link, and the image they already publish for their own link previews. Nothing is downloaded, re-hosted, or copied into a project. To add one: title, url, cover (an https image you are happy to link to), author, blurb. To drop one: delete the object. The API re-reads this file when it changes - no restart. Eight appear at a time (LAUNCHPAD_EXAMPLE_LIMIT, 12 maximum), so the rest of the list is in reserve, not lost. Point LAUNCHPAD_EXAMPLES_FILE somewhere else to keep your own list, and set LAUNCHPAD_EXAMPLES_SOURCE=off to hide the row's outside half entirely.
_verified: Titles, descriptions and cover URLs were read from each site's own og:title / og:description / og:image on 2026-09-05, and every cover answered 200 with an image type that day. If one stops loading, the card falls back to a colour block - it will not show a broken image.
